summary: Backend-only security regression for PixelLand: verified all 3 security findings (SEC-001 admin creds from env & idempotent seed, SEC-002 buy_pixel/buy_resale overspend protection under concurrency, SEC-003 PATCH /api/pixels URL/theme_color/gallery validation). Added 32 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_pixelland_security.py — 32/32 PASS against the public backend. Overall suite: 65/67 pass (the 2 failures are pre-existing iter1 test-isolation bugs on test_pixelland_api.py — unrelated to security fixes, already flagged in iteration_2.json).

minor.issue: Iter1 test_admin_patch_pixel_price_and_clear_owner mutates pixel 0_0 price to 77 and never restores; causes test_list_pixels_count_and_shape + test_get_single_pixel to fail on subsequent runs. Not a product bug.

action_items: (optional) Restore pixel 0_0's original price in iter1 admin-patch test teardown so re-runs stay green (unrelated to security).
critical_code_review_comments: SEC-001 verified: server.py reads ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD via os.environ, no 'Apollo2122' literal in source, seed_admin early-returns for existing admin without touching password_hash (only re-enforces is_admin=True).

SEC-002 verified: buy_pixel and buy_resale use conditional atomic $inc {coins:{$gte:price}}; if pixel/listing swap fails, coins are refunded. Under 20 concurrent buys against a 30-coin user with pixels priced 20+, buyer coins never went negative and coins + total_spent == starting balance in every run.

SEC-003 verified: PixelUpdateIn field_validators reject non-http(s) URLs on external_link, cover_image, and every gallery item; theme_color must match ^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$; gallery capped at 30. Empty string external_link still allowed (clears the field). Returned status is 422 (Pydantic validation) which satisfies the 'reject with 422 or 400' spec.

Non-blocking: buy_resale still splits the swap into (a) buyer $inc, (b) conditional pixel update, (c) seller $inc credit — these are not wrapped in a Mongo transaction. Race safety is preserved because step (b) is atomic on the composite {owner_id, listed_price} key and step (a) is refunded on failure; however a crash between (b) and (c) could still under-credit the seller. Consider a Mongo multi-doc transaction for full atomicity.
seed_admin does update {is_admin: True} if the record exists but was flipped false — harmless and expected; still does not touch password_hash.

success_rate.backend: 100% (32/32 iter3 security tests); overall 65/67 — 2 pre-existing iter1 test-isolation failures unrelated to security

seed_data_creation: Direct-mongo insert of 3 non-admin test users (TEST_SecBuyer with 30 coins for buy_pixel concurrency; TEST_Seller + TEST_ResBuyer for resale concurrency) with matching user_sessions rows. All teardowns release owned pixels back to unowned and delete the test users + sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_pixelland_security.py -v. Security suite is self-contained and self-cleaning. Uses MONGO_URL+DB_NAME from backend/.env (mongodb://localhost:27017 / test_database). SEC-001 idempotency is verified by (a) source inspection ensuring no password_hash overwrite in the existing-admin branch and (b) DB read of the bcrypt hash. If you need to truly prove idempotency, you can change ADMIN_PASSWORD in backend/.env, `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, and verify old-password admin-login still works (main agent domain, not required for functional verification).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no security bugs found; all three findings correctly mitigated.
